title: Atlas Robotics — warehouse picking robots
content: Atlas Robotics builds warehouse picking robots and sorting systems. Founded in 2019, headquartered in Rotterdam.

title: Atlas Gripper G2 — robotic gripper
content: The Atlas Gripper G2 is a robotic gripper that handles 40 kg payloads with adaptive finger control. It was released in March 2024 and costs $12,500.

title: Atlas Sorter S1 — parcel sorting
content: The Atlas Sorter S1 sorts 2,400 parcels per hour on a conveyor line. It costs $31,000 per unit and was released in June 2023.

title: Atlas API v3 documentation
content: The Atlas API v3 authenticates with OAuth2 client credentials. The default rate limit is 600 requests per minute and the SDK is published on PyPI.

title: Atlas Robotics pricing
content: Atlas Robotics pricing: Basic $500/month, Pro $2,000/month, Enterprise contact sales. Enterprise includes on-site installation.

title: Atlas Robotics leadership team
content: Dr. Lena Ortiz is the Chief Technology Officer of Atlas Robotics. Marcus Bell is the Vice President of Engineering. Priya Raman is the Chief Financial Officer.

title: How Northwind Logistics cut picking time with Atlas
content: Northwind Logistics reduced order picking time by 38 percent after deploying Atlas Gripper G2 units across two fulfilment centres.

title: Atlas Robotics support and SLA
content: Premium support from Atlas Robotics promises a 4 hour first response and 99.95 percent uptime. Standard support responds within one business day.

title: Careers at Atlas Robotics
content: Atlas Robotics is hiring in Rotterdam and Austin. Open roles include perception engineer and fleet reliability engineer.

title: Atlas Robotics security and compliance
content: Atlas Robotics is SOC 2 Type II certified. Customer data is stored in the EU and in the United States, with data residency selectable per account.

title: Atlas Robotics changelog
content: Atlas API v3.2 shipped in June 2025 and added battery diagnostics and a faster gripper calibration routine.

title: Atlas Gripper G1 — legacy robotic gripper
content: The Atlas Gripper G1 is the previous generation gripper. It handles 12 kg payloads and costs $6,900. It is no longer sold.

title: Atlas Mobility — electric vehicles
content: Atlas Mobility builds electric city cars and charging stations. It is a separate company from Atlas Robotics and shares no products with it.

title: Northwind Logistics — fulfilment and freight
content: Northwind Logistics is a third party fulfilment provider operating warehouses in eleven countries. It buys warehouse robotics but does not build it.

title: Managing an Atlas fleet
content: The Atlas Fleet Manager schedules robots across sites. A single deployment supports up to 250 Atlas Gripper G2 units under one control plane.

title: Atlas Sorter S2 — announced
content: The Atlas Sorter S2 is an announced second generation sorter with a target throughput of 3,100 parcels per hour. Availability is expected in 2027.

title: Contacting Atlas Robotics support
content: Support for Atlas Robotics is reachable at support@atlas-robotics.com and by phone on weekdays. Enterprise customers have a named support engineer.
